cohort: The study included 300 adult ASA grade I/II patients of either sex scheduled for various procedures under spinal anesthesia, divided into 100 Males, 100 Females, and 100 Pregnant Females.
finding: The mean skin to subarachnoid space depth (SSD) in the study population was 6.182+/-0.5603cm, with males exhibiting a higher SSD compared to non-pregnant females, and a new formula to calculate SSD using anthropometric data was derived.
cross-section timing: During the administration of spinal anesthesia at L3-L4 intervertebral space.
